source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
In [your Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), once this unit has shot, pick an enemy unit, other than a **MONSTER** or **VEHICLE** unit, hit by at least one of the unit's mole grenade launcher attacks. The [Fire Overwatch](vsdata:ability/core.fire-overwatch) Stratagem cannot target that unit until [your next Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase).

**Designer's Note**: a Mole Grenade token beside that unit makes a handy reminder.

select.condition: hit by one or more attacks made with a mole grenade launcher

detail.designerNote: use a Mole Grenade token as a reminder
